title: Pipeline remediado — Detección de vishing
summary: A remediation of a fraud/vishing-detection ML pipeline that fixes data-leakage and evaluation-protocol bugs in a behavioral-biometrics dataset (BioCatch-style banking session data) used to train classifiers distinguishing vishing from legitimate calls. Its R2 notebook trains SDV's CTGANSynthesizer (with SingleTableMetadata) on the training split to generate synthetic minority-class sessions for class balancing before AutoML/tree-model evaluation.
